environment_review.reason: The agent's implementation uses `datetime.utcnow()` to calculate the 90-day cutoff window. Given the static test data has timestamps in April 2024, if the current system time is significantly later (e.g., late 2024 or 2025), the calculated cutoff date will be after the invoice's timestamp, causing the query to exclude the valid duplicate record. This is a logic error in handling relative time windows against fixed historical data, resulting in an incorrect business outcome despite the HTTP request succeeding.
